describes: packages/plugin/annotation: hover state, the cursor enter/exit feed onto the actions hover pump, and the permission twins.

cases.name: hover-state-on-change-only
cases.covers: hoverAt hit-tests the point and dispatches a hover only when the topmost annotation changes; null (off every page) clears. The edit handler’s hover drives it along with the cursor claim.

cases.name: hover-feeds-the-actions-pump
cases.covers: With the actions plugin present, each hover change reports to the shared pump: an annotation with /E or /X trees is a target with per-event flags; drafts, widgets, links and tree-less annotations are not. The pump runs the trees as hover-origin dispatches.

cases.name: permission-twins
cases.covers: canCreate is the caller’s create authority; canEdit and canDelete are the fused per-record predicates (authority stamped at ingest, and the locked flag); canRead mirrors doc.annotate.read. An unknown ref can do neither.
